approach.label: Why work with me
approach.title: I don't just write code — I make operations measurably better.
approach.body: Give me a messy, real-world process and I'll turn it into a scalable system that runs itself. My core is automation and optimization: finding the bottleneck, modeling it, and shipping software that holds up under real load.
approach.body2: I adapt fast across domains — field logistics, HR, customs, agriculture — and I optimize for outcomes, not buzzwords. Every project here exists because it moved a number that mattered to the business.

route.desc: AI-powered route optimization for field operations, solving the Traveling Salesman Problem at scale with metaheuristics over real geospatial data.

bioterra.desc: Smart agriculture platform with real-time soil monitoring and blockchain-based traceability. First place in the environment vertical.

hr.desc: Full-stack organizational management system covering the full directorate hierarchy, with role-based interfaces for real-time structural changes.

customs.desc: Automated customs quotation management that removed manual bottlenecks and eliminated data-entry errors across internal workflows.

route.d: Add delivery stops and watch the route re-optimize live — the same class of problem behind my −35% travel-time system.

hand.d: Real-time hand-landmark detection with MediaPipe. Here the hand follows your cursor; in the live app it follows your camera.

crop.d: Move over the field to irrigate cells and watch yield climb — echoing the BioTerra project.
